observations.name: claims_below_severity_bar

report.title: What evidence bar applies at each claim severity, and who is allowed to lower it?
report.question_or_target: Define the minimum evidence a claim must carry as a function of its blast radius (P0 architectural commitment versus a P3 note) - number of independent sources, source-class diversity, whether an executable check is mandatory - and validate it by re-scoring 20 existing claims: how many currently sit below the bar their severity demands?

threshold_summary.P0: 3 distinct source identities, 3 source classes, a primary source, an executable check, and a both-states control
threshold_summary.P1: 2 distinct source identities, 2 source classes, a primary source, and an executable check whenever machine-testable
threshold_summary.P2: 2 distinct source identities, at least 1 class, with an executable check when machine-testable and action-gating
threshold_summary.P3: 1 source identity and 1 class; no executable check, but it must remain non-load-bearing

answer.who_may_lower_it: Nobody may lower the bar and still label an under-evidenced claim VERIFIED or CONFIRMED Prohibited from lowering any threshold or self-authorizing an exception Authorized humans may accept a scoped, expiring risk exception at the signatory levels in policy.json, while the claim remains BELOW-BAR.
answer.identity_rule: Counted independence is the number of distinct live byte identities (SHA-256 of stored_path bytes). Duplicate pointers, duplicate URLs, and duplicate SHA-256 values collapse to one identity before family or class labels are read. One identity contributes at most one family label and one class label (first listing wins). Both-states controls require two distinct identities labelled control_state=good and control_state=bad.
answer.status_quo_mutant: UNINFORMATIVE: it makes zero existing P0/P1 claims fail
answer.annotation_injection: CLOSED: one byte identity cannot be counted as three families or as both control states
answer.count_scope: 9/20 is the identity-bound result on the frozen live sample; duplicate LICENSE copies in RES-0144-C005 collapse to one identity

policy.identity_rule: Counted independence is the number of distinct live byte identities (SHA-256 of stored_path bytes). Duplicate pointers, duplicate URLs, and duplicate SHA-256 values collapse to one identity before family or class labels are read. One identity contributes at most one family label and one class label (first listing wins). Both-states controls require two distinct identities labelled control_state=good and control_state=bad.

universal_requirements.load_bearing_floor: At least two mechanically independent signals; a source and a verifier must both be named

P0.blast_radius: Irreversible or estate-wide architectural, security, release, or data-loss commitment
P0.decision_rule: No architectural commitment may be presented as verified below this bar

P1.blast_radius: Wide operational or release decision with costly but reversible consequences
P1.decision_rule: A mechanically testable P1 claim needs a recorded executable observation

P2.blast_radius: Bounded workflow, component, or research conclusion with local reversible impact
P2.decision_rule: The two-signal floor remains; same-class sources are allowed when their producer families are independent

P3.blast_radius: Non-load-bearing note, pointer, or descriptive fact that cannot gate a decision
P3.decision_rule: If a P3 claim becomes a premise or gates action, promote it to at least P2 before use

lowering_authority.verification_bar: Nobody may lower the bar and still label an under-evidenced claim VERIFIED or CONFIRMED
lowering_authority.automated_workers: Prohibited from lowering any threshold or self-authorizing an exception
lowering_authority.P0: A human repository owner and an independent P0 risk reviewer may jointly accept a time-bounded risk exception, but the claim remains BELOW-BAR and the universal floor is non-waivable
lowering_authority.P1: A human repository owner and an independent domain reviewer may jointly accept a scoped, expiring risk exception; the claim remains BELOW-BAR
lowering_authority.P2: The named domain owner may accept a scoped, expiring risk exception; the claim remains BELOW-BAR
lowering_authority.P3: The claim author may retain it only as an explicitly non-load-bearing UNVERIFIED note; promotion to a premise automatically invokes P2
non_waivable: source lineage for every counted source
two mechanically independent signals for every load-bearing claim
distinct lineage identities for counted independence

source_class_taxonomy.normative-primary: Specification, standard, authoritative vendor statement, or adopted policy bytes
source_class_taxonomy.primary-artifact: The thing itself, a direct corpus item, configuration, or original measurement input
source_class_taxonomy.primary-record: A time-locked claim, event, or decision record from its producing system
source_class_taxonomy.independent-analysis: Analysis produced independently from another analysis family
source_class_taxonomy.executable-observation: Recorded command, check-run, or recomputation that directly observes the proposition
source_class_taxonomy.derivative-receipt: A downstream report or receipt that restates upstream evidence
source_class_taxonomy.discovery-index: Search results or discovery output; useful for recall but not counted as truth evidence

calibration_guard.rule: At least one real P0 or P1 claim must fall below the proposed bar
calibration_guard.reason: A threshold that no current high-severity claim fails is observationally indistinguishable from fitting the bar to the status quo

report.sampling: Deterministic purposive severity-stratified sample of 20 existing recorded claims with live stored_path files

rescored_claims.claim: The rubric defines four claim-relative authority levels (A3 thing itself, A2 maintainer/operator, A1 practitioner, A0 re-teller) and four independent independence levels (I3 original artifact/observation, I2 independent analysis or reproduction, I1 derivative synthesis, I0 copy/restatement), with a byte-identity copy override that forces I0.
rescored_claims.severity_rationale: Defines the evidence-classification architecture used by downstream work
rescored_claims.original_named_independent_verification_: NIVP-RES0144-RUBRIC: PROBE-1 checked by PROBE-2

threshold.blast_radius: Irreversible or estate-wide architectural, security, release, or data-loss commitment
